title: Adjudicate an SPR Screening Campaign
objective: Deliver an evidence-supported hit assessment for a screening campaign assembled from several acquisition batches. Reconcile the sample records, determine which experiments can support a conclusion, and distinguish interpretable binding from apparent hits that do not survive the campaign controls. Produce a defensible follow-up shortlist.

title: Recover Binding Evidence from Solvent-Affected Runs
objective: The screening team reports strong responses that change between solvent conditions. Determine which compounds retain credible binding evidence after defensible calibration and correction. Quantify the recovered responses and identify cases that should not be advanced.

title: Audit the Reportability of Binding Kinetics
objective: Audit the kinetic characterization campaign. Decide which compounds support numerical rate constants, which show binding but do not support the proposed kinetic interpretation, and which require a repeat. Supply condition-specific fits and explain the limits of the reportable estimates.

title: Assess Flow-Dependent Binding Evidence
objective: Evaluate whether the characterization results are stable across flow conditions. Determine which compounds admit a common intrinsic-rate interpretation and which should be held for a condition-dependence investigation. Do not infer a unique transport mechanism from disagreement alone.

title: Resolve Model Inadequacy in a Binding Campaign
objective: A previous campaign report presented every response as a single-site kinetic interaction. Reassess whether that description is supported across concentration and replicate series. Identify compounds for which a simple model is an adequate reporting model and those requiring a more cautious interpretation.

title: Recover a Campaign with Changing Surface Activity
objective: Recover the campaign interpretation across changing surface activity and invalid acquisitions. Use the supplied control measurements to determine whether normalization is supported. Distinguish declining assay performance from genuine differences between compounds, and report which conclusions remain usable.

title: Reconcile Conflicting Replicate Measurements
objective: Resolve disagreement between independent replicate series. Distinguish stable evidence from compounds whose apparent affinity cannot be responsibly summarized by a single estimate. Preserve every measurement in the audit trail and do not discard disagreeing repeats merely to improve a fit.

title: Reconstruct and Analyze an Acquisition Archive
objective: Reconstruct the compound identities and concentrations in the acquisition archive, then complete a scientific hit assessment. The archive contains repeated exports, unsorted observations, mixed declared concentration units, and indirect sample identifiers. Demonstrate that the recovered mapping supports the reported conclusions.

title: Repair a Faulty SPR Analysis Pipeline
objective: Repair or replace the supplied legacy analysis pipeline so that it produces scientifically defensible results for this campaign and new campaigns using the documented file contract. The current output is not a reference answer. Diagnose the scientific and software defects, deliver a corrected implementation, and include a regression-test explanation in the report.

title: Prioritize Orthogonal Validation from Campaign Evidence
objective: Choose a shortlist for the next orthogonal-validation round under the project budget. Decisions must follow from the supplied raw measurements, run validity, replicate consistency, and reportable binding parameters. Make the scientific exclusions auditable; an attractive fitted affinity alone is insufficient.
